en.name: Astro Starlight
en.summary: Astro-based documentation theme. MDX content, auto-generated sidebar, built-in Pagefind search. Closest competitor in the field comparison.

en.name: Pagefind
en.summary: Static, dependency-free full-text search for static sites. Build-time indexer + self-contained JS+WASM widget.

en.name: Mermaid
en.summary: Diagram-as-code rendering library. Sequence, flow, gantt, state diagrams from text. Used in v1 for the <diagram> primitive.

en.name: MkDocs Material
en.summary: Python-based static site generator with the de-facto Material theme. Excellent chrome, content tabs, admonitions, instant page loading.

en.name: VitePress
en.summary: Vite + Vue static site generator aimed at technical documentation.
